angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 731,807 km at 177.11 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.6461 +/- 0.0133 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 177.11 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.0519 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2092 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract): 731,807 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.056 (1.015 to 1.096) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5842.06 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2092 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2092 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2092.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.418, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-2092: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2092 (pscomppars): [M/H] -0.1221 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2092 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.04981, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1505964178502982144, flags_flame 00: age_flame 0.66444814 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 0.2 to 1.622263)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, TOI-2092: projected rotation speed 1.52 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2022ApJS..259...35A)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
